_about: SLA rulebook for the SLA Report Bot. Edit values here; the bot follows them exactly and lists every rule it applied in the report's 'Rules Applied' sheet.

columns._about: Leave a value empty to let the bot auto-detect the column. Otherwise type the exact column name from your file.

date_format._about: day_first: true for 25/11/2026 style dates (India/UK), false for 11/25/2026 (US). 'auto' lets the bot decide from the data.

priority_aliases._about: Values found in a priority column are mapped to the four standard priorities (case-insensitive).

category_priority._about: Used only when the file has no priority column. Exact category names (case-insensitive) first, then keywords contained in the category or description.

clock._about: calendar = every day counts. business = only working days count (weekends and the holidays below are skipped).

as_of._about: Date used to judge open tickets. 'today', 'latest' (latest date found in the data), or a date like 2026-11-25.
